0022600198.text: The Utah Jazz (1-8, 14th in the West, on a seven-game losing streak) visit the Minnesota Timberwolves (7-3, 6th in the West, winners of three straight) for the Jazz's 10th game of the season. Utah is without Jaren Jackson Jr. (knee) and Jusuf Nurkic (foot strain), both out, and Lauri Markkanen (wrist sprain) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, while Minnesota is missing Anthony Edwards (knee surgery) and Donte DiVincenzo (Achilles surgery), with Joan Beringer day-to-day with a fracture. The teams have not met yet in the 2026-27 season, and in 2025-26 the Jazz lost the season series 1-3, including a 147-111 loss in Minneapolis on March 18.
